# Test grammar

The generated parser (`src/`) and highlight query (`queries/`) of
[tree-sitter-json](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-json) 0.24.8,
copied unchanged so the language pack tests (`tests/plugin_packages.rs`)
can compile and load a real grammar.
